questions.question: How does fog computing prevent unnecessary noisy big data from crowding the cloud?

options.a: By storing all raw data permanently in the cloud
options.b: By performing prior filtration at the edge
options.d: By increasing the frequency of sensor transmission

questions.correct_answer: By performing prior filtration at the edge

questions.question: Which statement best describes Software-Defined Automation?

options.b: It eliminates real-time control from industrial systems

questions.correct_answer: It uses a virtualized platform for dynamic, real-time system control
